LanguageData.RM_GreyCrustDoorLabel: The sea has salted a door
LanguageData.RM_GreyCrustDoorText: Salt has grown into the seams of one of the ship's outer doors and frozen it shut. The Grey builds on anything that holds still long enough, and a parked ship is the stillest thing it has ever held.\n\nA salted door will not open from either side until someone chips it free — a short job that needs no tools, and the salt you knock out is yours. Left parked, the ship will rime white, then its doors will salt one by one, and after long neglect crust will jacket the whole hull and must be chipped off before the ship can launch. Salt snow and a berth beside brine channels or chimney fields speed it all up. Leaving stops the clock.
LanguageData.RM_GreyCrustDoorInspect: Salted shut — chip it free to open
LanguageData.RM_GravEngineCannotLaunchGreyCrust: Salt crust jackets the hull — {0} patches must be chipped off before launching
LanguageData.RM_GreyTearFreeDesc: Rip the ship loose of the Grey Sea's salt: all hull crust is torn off, every salted door is wrenched free, and every building on the hull takes {0}% of its hit points in damage. Needs no worker and cannot be blocked. Then launch as usual.
LanguageData.RM_GreyTearFreeConfirm: Tear the ship free? All crust is ripped off and every building on the hull is badly damaged (never destroyed). You will need repairs.
LanguageData.RM_GreyTearFreeDone: The hull screams free of the salt. {0}
